items.title: 中國 AI 模型附和國家教條或拒絕回答敏感話題 / Chinese AI models parrot state doctrine or refuse to answer on sensitive topics

sources.title: 中國 AI 模型附和國家教條或拒絕回答敏感話題 / Chinese AI models parrot state doctrine or refuse to answer on sensitive topics
sources.title_zh: 中國 AI 模型附和國家教條或拒絕回答敏感話題
sources.title_en: Chinese AI models parrot state doctrine or refuse to answer on sensitive topics
sources.title_original: Chinese AI models parrot state doctrine or refuse to answer on sensitive topics
sources.summary: Chinese AI models often follow the party line on politically sensitive questions, according to an Aleph Alpha study that rated only 17 to 41 percent of answers as balanced. Aleph Alpha sells "sovereign AI" to governments, giving it a commercial interest in distinguishing its models from Chinese competitors. The article Chinese AI models parrot state doctrine or refuse to answer on sensitive topics appeared first on The Decoder .
sources.summary_zh: 根據 Aleph Alpha 的一項研究，中國 AI 模型在政治敏感問題上通常遵循黨的路線，僅有 17% 至 41% 的回答被評為平衡。Aleph Alpha 向政府銷售「主權 AI」，這使其在將自家模型與中國競爭對手區分開來方面具有商業利益。這篇題為「中國 AI 模型附和國家教條或拒絕回答敏感話題」的文章最初發表於 The Decoder。

items.title: DeepSeek Harness v0.2 為其開源代理框架帶來官方桌面應用程式 / DeepSeek Harness v0.2 Brings Official Desktop Apps to Its Open-Source Agent Harness

sources.title: DeepSeek Harness v0.2 為其開源代理框架帶來官方桌面應用程式 / DeepSeek Harness v0.2 Brings Official Desktop Apps to Its Open-Source Agent Harness
sources.title_zh: DeepSeek Harness v0.2 為其開源代理框架帶來官方桌面應用程式
sources.title_en: DeepSeek Harness v0.2 Brings Official Desktop Apps to Its Open-Source Agent Harness
sources.title_original: DeepSeek Harness v0.2 Brings Official Desktop Apps to Its Open-Source Agent Harness
sources.summary: DeepSeek has released official macOS and Windows desktop apps for DeepSeek Harness v0.2, its MIT-licensed agent harness. The preview adds a plugin manager, file and code-change review, and scheduled Automation Tasks. It also supports non-DeepSeek models through OpenAI-compatible endpoints. The post DeepSeek Harness v0.2 Brings Official Desktop Apps to Its Open-Source Agent Harness appeared first on MarkTechPost .
sources.summary_zh: DeepSeek 已針對採用 MIT 授權的代理程式框架 DeepSeek Harness v0.2 發布了官方 macOS 與 Windows 桌面應用程式。此次預覽版新增了外掛程式管理員、檔案與程式碼變更審查，以及排程自動化任務。它也透過相容 OpenAI 的端點支援非 DeepSeek 的模型。本文〈DeepSeek Harness v0.2 Brings Official Desktop Apps to Its Open-Source Agent Harness〉最初發布於 MarkTechPost。
